heading: Five questions for your IUL review (72 seconds)
name: Own an IUL? Five questions for your annual review
description: If you own an indexed universal life policy, you can ask the insurer for an in-force illustration after the first policy anniversary. This short video shows how to read it and five questions to check each year. General education, not tax advice.
transcript: Own an IUL? Here are five questions for your annual review. Start by asking the insurer for an in-force illustration. It is the insurer's updated projection of your policy. After the first policy anniversary, you can ask for one. The guaranteed column shows only what the policy guarantees. The non-guaranteed column can change. 1. Does the guaranteed column end, and when? 2. Is a loan balance growing? 3. Is your premium below what was illustrated? 4. When do surrender charges end? 5. What are the current cap and participation rate? Caps and participation rates limit index credits. Policy charges reduce the cash value. Surrender charges may apply. Guarantees depend on the insurer's ability to pay claims. A new policy has its own costs. The old policy may deduct surrender charges. Replacing a policy is suitable only some of the time. This is general education, not tax advice. Want to talk it through? Schedule a time at honorbrook-insurance.com, or call (301) 615-8289.
